'''RP-G0''' was an [[astromech droid]]<ref name="TFAVD" /> in [[Industrial Automaton]]'s [[R5 series astromech droid|R5 line]]<ref name="CT" /> that served in the [[Resistance]] during their [[Cold War|conflict]] with the [[First Order]]. The [[droid]] was assigned to the [[Sullustan]] [[pilot]] [[Nien Nunb]].<ref name="Flight Log">''[[Poe Dameron: Flight Log]]''</ref> Around thirty [[Standard year|years]] after the [[Battle of Endor]],<ref name="TFAVD" /> it was stationed in the Resistance's [[Resistance base|base of operations]] on the [[planet]] [[D'Qar]] and took part in the preparation for their [[Battle of Starkiller Base|attack]] on the First Order's [[Starkiller Base]] [[superweapon]].<ref name="TFA">{{Film|VII}}</ref> RP-G0 had [[Color|red]] and white plating<ref name="TFAVD" /> and stood 0.97 [[meter]]s tall.<ref name="DB" /> It was equipped with a [[Burtt acoustic signaler]].<ref name="TFAVD" />

==Behind the scenes==
RP-G0 first appeared in [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']], a film released in North America on [[December 18]], [[2015]]. It was not identified in the film, but received a designation in the reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens: The Visual Dictionary]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and released in conjunction with the film. Two droids with RP-G0's coloration can be seen in the same shot in the film, one of which is loaded into the [[T-70 X-wing starfighter]] opposite the [[Millennium Falcon]] on D'Qar prior to the Battle of Starkiller Base and the other of which can be seen on the ground beside the same X-wing. It is unclear which of these droids is RP-G0.
